parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The bug is that the `nodesseen` set is being updated with all successors of the current node, not just the new ones. This causes nodes to be added multiple times to the queue and checked multiple times, leading to incorrect results. The fix is to only add new successors to the queue and update the `nodesseen` set.

modifications.anchor: queue.extend(node for node in node.successors if node not in nodesseen)
modifications.code: queue.extend(successor for successor in node.successors if successor not in nodesseen and successor not in queue)
nodesseen.update(successor for successor in node.successors if successor not in nodesseen)
